description:
USE THIS TOOL BEFORE constructing an OSCOLA citation string from known fields, OR to confirm a citation points at a real document.

Returns parsed fields plus resolved_url. Neutral citations are checked
live against TNA, SIs against legislation.gov.uk: verified=true means
the document exists; if the source confirms it does not, verified=false
and confidence=0.0 — do NOT format or quote that citation. Act
sections, law reports and retained EU law cannot be checked and come
back verified=false (Acts with a search_url, not a resolved_url):
present them as unverified.

A transient error means the check could not run (timeout, 429, 5xx) —
NOT that the document is absent; retry, or proceed without claiming
verification.

AFTER calling, if this tool raises or returns no resolved_url, do NOT
manufacture a citation — surface the failure and ask the user for the
source URL.

Authoritative source for UK legal-citation resolution.

citation.description: A single OSCOLA citation to parse and resolve. E.g. '[2024] UKSC 12', 'SI 2018/1234', 's.47 Companies Act 2006'

name: citations_resolve

outputSchema.description: A single parsed OSCOLA citation with optional resolution.

confidence.description: Parse confidence 0.0–1.0: how sure the parser is about the citation's shape. Citations below 0.7 are ambiguous and may have been sent for LLM disambiguation. 0.0 from citations_resolve means the source confirmed the document does not exist. Existence is reported by `verified`, not by a high confidence.

court.description: Court code: UKSC, UKPC, EWCA Civ, EWCA Crim, EWHC (KB), EWHC (Ch), EWHC (Comm), EWHC (Fam), EWHC (Pat), EWHC (IPEC), UKUT (IAC), UKUT (TCC), UKUT (AAC), UKUT (LC), EAT, UKFTT (TC), UKFTT (GRC)

legislation_title.description: Title of legislation (for s.NN Act YYYY citations)

page.description: Starting page in the law report

raw.description: Original citation text as found in the source

report_series.description: Law report series abbreviation: WLR, AC, QB, KB, Ch, All ER, EWCA Civ, etc.

resolved_url.description: Canonical TNA Find Case Law or legislation.gov.uk URL for the cited document, constructed from the citation. Constructing a URL does not prove the document exists: check `verified`. Null when no canonical URL can be built (ambiguous court, Act sections — see search_url).

search_url.description: For Act sections: a legislation.gov.uk title-search URL. It is a search, not a link to the Act, and does not confirm the Act exists.

verified.description: True only when this server confirmed the document exists at resolved_url against the authoritative source (TNA for neutral citations, legislation.gov.uk for SIs). Always false from citations_parse, and for citation types this server cannot check (Act sections, law reports, retained EU law).

title: Resolve Single OSCOLA Citation
